game.name: Naruto Shippuden : Ultimate Ninja Storm Generation (Europe)
game.desc: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations is a fighting game for Xbox 360. The story mode features 10 scenarios that cover the entire series. The game features 72 fighters, with the possibility of using support characters to perform combined attacks. New variants are available for free and online battles.
